placements.why: src-1 and src-2 establish the ratified asynchronous job contract for remember, where dispatch immediately returns a receipt and extraction progress is retrieved via cursor polling or piggybacked reactions without blocking or losing work.
placements.title: Decoupling memory extraction into non-blocking receipts and asynchronous polling
placements.frame: How does the remember interface handle long-running extractions, receipts, and result delivery without blocking callers or risking lost work?
